timings.title: MedWatch · A clearer story between care visits
timings.text: A fictional-data prototype for older adults and caregivers. Capture the details, then bring a better record to a visit.

timings.title: Start with the patient’s own words
timings.text: The full manual check-in always works. AI can suggest answers, but the patient chooses what to keep.

timings.title: Real AI, running on this device
timings.text: Qwen2.5 runs in a WebGPU worker. These fresh prompts and records do not go to a cloud AI service.

timings.title: Every suggestion comes with its evidence
timings.text: The host checks the response and source quotes. Nothing has been saved yet.

timings.title: The patient confirms the final record
timings.text: Unanswered fields stay unknown. A correction preserves the earlier version instead of creating a duplicate day.

timings.title: A shared picture for the caregiver
timings.text: Descriptive counts and charts come from confirmed answers. Missing days remain visible as gaps.

timings.title: Follow a finding back to the original record
timings.text: Answered days form the denominator. Caregiver notes are kept separate from patient answers.

timings.title: Ask what the record actually shows
timings.text: AI wording includes source links. Diagnosis, medication decisions and care timing are outside this tool’s scope.

timings.title: Prepare a conversation, with review built in
timings.text: AI drafts discussion wording. Code renders the medication list and numerical facts. Pinned concerns stay in the author’s own words.

timings.title: Reviewed and ready to print
timings.text: The user can save a PDF locally. Nothing is sent to a clinician and no one is monitoring the app.

timings.title: Working prototype. Honest boundaries.
timings.text: Local AI and records are working. Source explanations await qualified review; real-patient use and clinical validation are not part of this demo.
